traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for 010.3-DEV-MIGRATE-TO-SUPPORTS are implemented and verified. The optional rule `traceability/prefer-implements-annotation` is present, disabled by default, configurable to warn/error, and implements conservative auto-fix behavior for simple single-story @story + @req patterns while detecting and warning about mixed and multi-story scenarios without performing unsafe fixes. Legacy @story/@req annotations and pure @supports annotations remain valid and unaffected when the rule is off, and documentation in user-docs/migration-guide.md explains the migration, configuration, and auto-fix behavior in line with the story. All associated unit tests, including those specifically referencing this story and its requirements, pass successfully.
